data.narrative:
Artimus Robotics is a Seed-stage robotics and manufacturing company founded by Eric Acome, Shane Mitchell, Nick Kellaris, and Christoph Keplinger. The company has raised $5M+ to date. The applicable comp universe includes 8 private robotics peers (including Walden Robotics, Divergent, Exotec, Locus Robotics, and Bedrock Robotics) and 1 public comparable.

Stage-progression methodology is the primary applicable valuation approach. Using total capital raised of $5M as a baseline value proxy and applying a typical Seed-to-next-stage step-up multiplier of 2.5x yields an implied valuation of $12M. A peer-median approach could not be reliably applied due to insufficient datapoints within narrow peer filters (same-stage, adjacent-stage, or similar-valuation-tier peers)—while 8 same-sector robotics companies exist, none satisfied the minimum threshold of 3 comparables in tightly defined cohorts.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $11M to $14M, with a median of $12M. This estimate carries meaningful uncertainty given reliance on a single methodological pillar and the lack of sufficiently granular peer benchmarking data. The valuation range reflects ±15% sensitivity around the stage-progression result. Key uncertainties include the absence of revenue or unit economics data, which would anchor a revenue-multiple or DCF approach, and the limited sample of late-stage robotics comparables at comparable funding intensity. Future rounds or milestone data would materially strengthen conviction in this range.
